metaDescription: Celebrate Lighting won Oakville's 2026 Permanent Lighting award. See its WiFi app-controlled system, 25-year warranty and annual maintenance plan.
summary: Celebrate Lighting installs permanent, WiFi-connected LED track lighting for homeowners and businesses across Southern Ontario, colour-matched to each building's soffit and fascia. Every system is app-controlled and backed by a 25-year warranty.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Celebrate Lighting installs new permanent LED lighting systems and also offers repair service and existing light replacement for homeowners upgrading an older or failing setup. Colour-matching each track to the building's soffit and fascia is a core design step, meant to keep the hardware unobtrusive during the day while enabling a full light show at night. The company works with both residential homeowners and commercial businesses.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: A free consultation starts the process, followed by installation of a WiFi-connected, app-controlled system backed by a 25-year warranty, among the longer warranty terms in the permanent lighting category. Annual maintenance is offered as an ongoing service rather than a one-time install-and-forget approach. The company also describes a transparent quoting process, giving customers a clear price before work begins.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer called the installation flawless and the lights absolutely stunning, saying they can now enjoy lighting for every holiday without the hassle of decorations. Another described the service as professional from start to finish, noting the team was punctual and respectful and that the quality of work exceeded expectations.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Celebrate Lighting is based in Oakville and serves homeowners and businesses across Southern Ontario. Homeowners should confirm coverage of their specific address, since permanent lighting installs require an in-person site visit.

strengths: Backed by a 25-year warranty, among the longer terms offered in the permanent lighting category.
Colour-matched to soffit and fascia for a discreet daytime look.
Offers annual maintenance as an ongoing service, not just a one-time install.
Also handles repair and replacement of existing failing lighting systems.
considerations: Permanent lighting carries a higher upfront cost than a single season of rented holiday lights.
Best suited to homeowners planning to stay in the property long enough to use the 25-year warranty.
Serves a broad Southern Ontario area, so confirm site-visit availability for your specific address.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting one lighting system for every holiday and occasion
Businesses wanting permanent, colour-matched exterior lighting
Replacing an existing, failing permanent lighting system
Anyone wanting an ongoing annual maintenance plan
questionsToAsk: What does the 25-year warranty cover, and what is excluded?
What is included in the annual maintenance plan, and is it optional?
How is the track colour matched to my specific soffit and fascia?
If I already have permanent lighting, can you replace just the failing sections?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Celebrate Lighting was selected as the top business in the Permanent Outdoor Lighting category for Oakville through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do they work with businesses as well as homeowners?
faq.a: Yes. The company serves both homeowners and businesses across Southern Ontario with the same permanent lighting system.

faq.q: Can they fix an existing permanent lighting system from another installer?
faq.a: Repair Service and Existing Light Replacement are both listed among the company's services, so it does take on repair and replacement work, not only new installations.

faq.q: What warranty comes with a new installation?
faq.a: The company backs new installations with a 25-year warranty, according to its listed service description.
